example.title: Cohas Brook Bridge, NH Route 28 (South Willow Street) over Cohas Brook

brief: Open-spandrel reinforced-concrete parabolic arch of 1929 on a city-edge state highway: twin arch ribs 6 ft wide at 20 ft centres, 61 ft 4 in main span with a 16.7 ft rise, carrying the deck on slender spandrel columns, plus concrete slab approach spans (139 ft 8 in overall), 27 ft 4 in wide with a 24 ft roadway. Ribs spring from abutments braced by a horizontal concrete shear panel; paneled concrete railing with square posts. Wooded ravine with birches and rip-rapped banks under power lines; original construction drawings are among the photos.
